entities.summary: Matthew John Breida is an American former professional football player who was a running back for seven seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Southern Eagles and signed with the 49ers as an undrafted free agent in 2017. Breida also played for the Miami Dolphins, Buffalo Bills, and New York Giants.
